thread:
sophia: Hey — quick question. I'm trying to run a one-off embeddings job for a PoC (~250k docs, ~3M tokens) from my laptop using the hosted sandbox key and I'm hitting 429s. Error looks like:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-ratelimit-type: token
retry-after: 60
```
Is there a short process to get a temporary bump for a single-job run? I don't need prod access, just a 2‑hour window. Who should I ping? @infra-team? :pray:

infra-bot: Heads up — hosted "sandbox" keys have fixed default quotas. For short-term bumps open a request to infra@redwood.com with subject "sandbox-bump" and include: token (or account id), expected total tokens, desired max qps, and duration. Include whether this is streaming or batch. Auto-approval often for <= 10M tokens and <= 4h.

ben: Another option — if you can upload your payload to an internal tmp S3 bucket, we can run it in a reserved batch window which avoids touching the hosted quota. I can schedule if you share the s3 path.

sophia: Thanks — it's currently local data. Is it okay to push an obfuscated sample to a tmp bucket? I can strip PII and push just the embedding inputs.

marcus: @sophia that's fine. If you need something faster I can create an ephemeral elevated token (2h) for you. Ping me the run window and I'll issue it. Note: ephemeral tokens are tracked in the audit log.

sam_devx: quick reminder — don't check any keys into repos or CI. For batch jobs prefer the embeddings-batch-s3 pattern Ben mentioned. Also confirm data masking for customer PoCs.

ops-rita: tagging ops — we'll need a billing code/cost center for the bump. Sophia, can you add that and the expected run time here?

sophia: Added cost center "growth-poc" and tentative window tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PST. I'll sanitize and upload to s3 and share the path by EOD. Thanks everyone :rocket:
